basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old living in Gainesville, Florida, who recently got into vaping and cannabis culture. By day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, which allows me the flexibility to dive into my latest interests. I'm single and often spend my evenings exploring new hobbies and learning online. I usually browse Reddit late at night, around 10 PM to 1 AM, while sipping on herbal tea. I'm keen on understanding the ins and outs of vaping, especially filling my own cartridges to save money. When I'm not working or browsing Reddit, I'm likely tinkering with music production software or catching up on comedy shows.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm new to vaping and cannabis, having started less than a year ago. Most of my knowledge comes from online forums, YouTube tutorials, and advice from more experienced friends. I also have a budding interest in sound design and music production, which I'm learning through online courses and trial-and-error with software like Renoise.
